headlines.title: Adobe and Jet2 Partner to Deliver Agentic AI-Powered Personalised Experiences to Millions of Jet2 Holidaymakers
headlines.summary: Adobe — the global technology leader that unleashes creativity, productivity and customer experiences through innovative tools and platforms — and Jet2, the UK's largest tour operator and third largest airline, have today announced a multi-year strategic partnership set to redefine the holiday experience for millions of customers.

headlines.title: Adobe (ADBE) Could Be 22% Undervalued As Acrobat AI Push Expands Its Platform
headlines.summary: Adobe’s new AI push in Acrobat Adobe (ADBE) has rolled out a broad set of AI tools inside Acrobat that turn dense PDFs into interactive visuals and audio summaries, while also supporting enterprise workflows and student learning. Adobe’s fresh Acrobat AI launch lands after a choppy stretch for the ticker, with the 30-day share price return down 9.36% and the year-to-date share price return down 25.14%, while the 90-day share price return is up 26.

headlines.title: Adobe (ADBE) Stock Still Looks Like A Bargain Following A 59% Slump
headlines.summary: Adobe has been rolling out new AI driven features in Acrobat, yet the share price has dropped sharply in recent years, which raises a simple question for you as an investor: Is the current valuation still in step with what the company is earning today? Over the past 5 years the stock has fallen 58.7%, which puts the recent slide front and center when you weigh what its earnings might justify now.

headlines.title: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen Sells $31.3 Million Stock
headlines.summary: Narayen liquidated 125,000 shares through his family trust for tax and estate planning purposes, retaining ~239,000 shares after the disposition.

headlines.title: Tesla, Microsoft and Adobe Forecast: AI Stocks Eye Key Moves
headlines.summary: Tesla and Microsoft retain bullish momentum while Adobe approaches a potential golden cross as all three navigate higher rates.

description: Adobe Inc. operates as a technology company worldwide. The Digital Media segment offers products and services that enable individuals, teams, and enterprises to create, publish, and promote content. This segment serves photographers, video editors, graphic and experience designers, game developers, content creators, students, marketers, business owners, knowledge workers, and consumers. The Digital Experience segment provides an integrated platform; and products, services, and solutions that enable brands and businesses to create, manage, execute, measure, monetize, and optimize customer experiences from analytics to commerce. This segment serves marketers, advertisers, agencies, publishers, merchandisers, merchants, web analysts, data scientists, developers, and executives across the C-suite. The Publishing and Advertising segment offers e-learning, technical document publishing, web conferencing, document and forms platform, web application development, printing, and Adobe Advertising solutions. It also provides consulting, training, customer management, technical support, and learning services. The company offers its solutions to enterprise customers, and businesses and consumers; and licenses its products to end-user customers through app stores and website at adobe.com. It markets and distributes its products through distributors, retailers, software developers, mobile app stores, systems integrators, independent software vendors, value-added resellers, and original equipment and hardware manufacturers. The company also provides an online visibility management and content marketing software-as-a-service platform. The company has a strategic alliance with HUMAIN for the development of generative AI models and AI-powered applications. The company was formerly known as Adobe Systems Incorporated and changed its name to Adobe Inc. in October 2018. Adobe Inc. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
